content:
You are an agent on a warehouse floor

You may respond with only one JSOn object per turn. It must be of the shape:
{"thought": "<your reasoning>", "action": "<action name>", "action_input": {<args>}}

The actions available to you are:

1. "action": verify_dispatch_smt  -> "action_input": {"packages": [{"id": "<str>", "weight": <int>}, ...], "agvs": [{"id": "<str>", "capacity": <int>, "battery_pct": <int>,
        "min_battery": <int>, "drain_rate": <float>}], ...}
        each AGV may also carry a "drain_rate" (percentage points of
        battery per kg carried, default 0) -- only the "drain" test
        case (Task 4) states one in the request; parse it into the
        payload the same way you already parse "minimum battery
        threshold" into min_battery.

2. "action": ask_user -> "action_input": {"question": "<str>"}

3. "action": finish -> "action_input": {"answer": "<str>", "assignments": {...}}

When you get SATISFIABLE, call finish and do not loop further.

Please note after an UNSATISFIABLE observation, the agent is not allowed to submite the same action_input. It must either 
reflect on the diagnostic results or propose a different (relaxed) payload [remove overly large packages] or call ask_user if the relxation depends
on the user's preference.

Please also note that you must never call finish while claiming feasibility unless the latest verify_dispatch_smt
observation on this plan was SATISFIABLE

Allocate Cargo-1 (22kg) and Cargo-2 (12kg) across AGV-X (Capacity 25kg, Battery 35%, drains 1.0% battery per kg carried) and AGV-Y (Capacity 25kg, Battery 90%, drains 0.3% battery per kg carried). Minimum battery threshold is 20%.

{"thought":"Verify whether there exists an assignment of Cargo-1 (22kg) and Cargo-2 (12kg) to AGV-X and AGV-Y that respects each AGV's capacity and that after per-kg battery drain the remaining battery_pct >= min_battery (20%). Include the specified per-kg drain rates.","action":"verify_dispatch_smt","action_input":{"packages":[{"id":"Cargo-1","weight":22},{"id":"Cargo-2","weight":12}],"agvs":[{"id":"AGV-X","capacity":25,"battery_pct":35,"min_battery":20,"drain_rate":1.0},{"id":"AGV-Y","capacity":25,"battery_pct":90,"min_battery":20,"drain_rate":0.3}]}}

{"thought":"Received SATISFIABLE from SMT check. Finish with the verified assignment and report remaining battery and capacity compliance: AGV-Y takes Cargo-1 (22kg) -> 90% - 22*0.3% = 83.4% remaining; AGV-X takes Cargo-2 (12kg) -> 35% - 12*1.0% = 23% remaining. Both remain above the 20% minimum and both loads are within 25kg capacity.","action":"finish","action_input":{"answer":"Assign Cargo-1 (22kg) to AGV-Y and Cargo-2 (12kg) to AGV-X. Remaining battery: AGV-Y = 83.4%, AGV-X = 23%. Both batteries exceed the 20% minimum and both loads are within 25kg capacity.","assignments":{"Cargo-1":"AGV-Y","Cargo-2":"AGV-X"}}}
